environment: Linux cloud container; native Xvfb / Mesa llvmpipe software OpenGL; Chromium SwiftShader WebGL2
delivery: Local uncommitted changes and rebuilt browser pack. No push, publication or deployment.

scenario_generation.note: The route is a 3+5 nm dogleg. Turning, waypoint acceptance and the exit radius affect measured arrival; the generic merchant keeps its existing 15 kn cap.

mission_trials.method: Real Main scene, normal issue_order commands, actual fixed ticks, sensors, AI, weapons and damage. No injected contacts, damage, ammunition or outcomes. This is an automated command policy, not a human playtest.

passage_native_ui.visual_inspection: Inspected real desk, briefing, command, engagement and debrief captures. Chart and three lower panes fit; report is scrollable. Pixel sizes are 1280x720 and 1920x1080; Godot canvas scaling keeps a 1600x900 logical layout.

other_theatre_visuals.observed: Gulf/Hormuz, Mediterranean/Tartus and Pacific/Spratly render geography, tracks, regional view, ship and data panes at 1280x720. Actual selected vessels are Paul Ignatius, Mistral and Lapu-Lapu Trader respectively.

browser.limitations: Browser check covers boot and controls, not a complete browser battle, browser save persistence or a performance claim.

expanded_3d_warning_comparison.trigger: G swaps the 3D view into the large pane; warnings start in the swap stage. Normal command view, F3 and Shift+E produce none in the staged comparison.
expanded_3d_warning_comparison.baseline_method: git show HEAD:docs/play/index.pck and original HTML, served locally with the same 4.7.2 runtime and Chromium/SwiftShader settings; opened Northern Convoy and exercised G.
expanded_3d_warning_comparison.status: Existing renderer limitation reproduced in both packages; not repaired in this bounded mission milestone.

diagnostics: Some automated exits report 2-10 ObjectDB instances retained at shutdown; no SCRIPT ERROR or unexpected runtime errors were reported by the mission driver. No broad lifecycle repair is claimed.

Initial patrol balance allowed unprotected delivery. The final opposing frigate uses the existing breakout posture and its own sensors; the final abandonment policies both fail through freighter loss.
limits: Mid-engagement save/load is not implemented. Scenario JSON saves definitions only.
Existing 1x/2x/5x/10x/30x/60x compression remains, rather than the destination brief’s proposed 4x and 8x choices.
Attributed neutral losses use the existing last-attacker faction, retained through later flooding/fire; mixed-attack proportional responsibility is not modeled.
Journal retains the latest 512 player-observed messages and discloses omitted messages.
Automatic defence is enabled initially. The player policy uses NSM, but victory does not require destroying either opposing combatant.
RED collateral damage sank Coastal Star in both escort seeds; this is reported as an observed loss and is not charged as a player-caused sinking.
Combat figures, timings, readiness, single-helicopter detachment and magazines remain gameplay assumptions. No new real-world performance claims.
No new frame-rate benchmark or full supplied-brief completion claim.

Expanded 3D view under Chromium 151 / SwiftShader emits WebGL INVALID_OPERATION buffer warnings. The same trigger reproduces in the unchanged starting export. Normal browser view and controls did not emit warnings in the staged comparison.

scenario_sweep.execution: Started with the existing serial sweep; seed 13 and the last three seed-2 cases ran as independent subprocesses in parallel. Stopped the remaining duplicate serial queue after all 46 distinct cases passed.
scenario_sweep.scope: All shipped scenarios; no custom stress fixtures. This is fixed-duration AI execution validation, not a claim every operation reaches victory.
